A1.name: En el aula
A1.scope: hello & goodbye, classroom language, numbers 1-10, the alphabet

A1.name: Nosotros y nosotras
A1.scope: ser / tener / llamarse, personal pronouns; numbers, nationalities, professions, workplaces

A1.name: Quiero aprender español
A1.scope: gender, definite/indefinite articles, presente de indicativo (regular -ar/-er/-ir), por/para/porque; languages, class & leisure activities

A1.name: ¿Dónde está Santiago?
A1.scope: uses of hay, the verb estar, the superlative, quantifiers muy/mucho, interrogatives qué/cuál/cuántos/dónde/cómo; climate & weather, geography, countries, cardinal points, seasons

A1.name: ¿Cuál prefieres?
A1.scope: demonstratives este/esta/estos/estas/esto, cuál/cuáles, tener que + infinitive, verbs ir & preferir; numbers over 100, colours, clothes & accessories, everyday objects, llevar

A1.name: Tus amigos son mis amigos
A1.scope: the verb gustar, quantifiers muy/bastante/un poco, possessives, también/tampoco, diacritical accents; family, personality adjectives, music

A1.name: Día a día
A1.scope: presente de indicativo (irregular verbs), pronominal/reflexive verbs, frequency, sequence primero/después/luego; days of the week, times of day, daily activities

A1.name: ¡A comer!
A1.scope: verbs poner & traer, direct object pronouns lo/la/los/las, uses of de & con; food, ways of cooking, utensils, typical dishes

A1.name: El barrio ideal
A1.scope: quantifiers algún/ningún/mucho, prepositions & adverbs of place (a, en, al lado de, cerca, lejos); services & places in a city, adjectives

A1.name: ¿Sabes conducir?
A1.scope: the pretérito perfecto, saber + infinitive, poder + infinitive; professions, personality adjectives, skills & abilities

A2.name: El español y tú
A2.scope: the presents (regular & irregular), reflexive verbs, costar & sentirse, para/porque, desde / desde hace / hace… que; feelings, activities for learning languages, professions, the alphabet

A2.name: Una vida de película
A2.scope: form & uses of the pretérito indefinido, empezar a + infinitive, ir/irse, past temporal markers, prepositions desde/durante/hasta; cinema, biographies

A2.name: Hogar, dulce hogar
A2.scope: comparatives, prepositions of place (sin, con, debajo, encima, detrás, delante), possessive pronouns (el mío/la mía…), uses of ser & estar, verbs gustar/encantar/preferir; types of housing, parts of a home, shapes/styles/materials

A2.name: ¿Cómo va todo?
A2.scope: the gerundio (regular & irregular), estar + gerundio, the condicional; greetings & farewells, courtesy verbs (poder, importar, ayudar, poner), dar/dejar/prestar

A2.name: Guía del ocio
A2.scope: the pretérito perfecto, ya / todavía no, ir a + infinitive, querer/pensar + infinitive; leisure activities & places, travel

A2.name: No como carne
A2.scope: direct object pronouns, impersonal forms with se, some uses of ser & estar, y/pero/además; food, recipes, weights & measures

A2.name: Nos gustó mucho
A2.scope: uses of pretérito perfecto vs indefinido, me/te/le/nos/os/les gustaría + infinitive, exclamative sentences; parecer, caer bien/mal, pasárselo bien/mal, places of interest & cultural offerings

A2.name: Estamos muy bien
A2.scope: uses of ser & estar, the verb doler, form & uses of the affirmative imperative; parts of the body, moods, illnesses & symptoms

A2.name: Antes y ahora
A2.scope: the pretérito imperfecto, ya no / todavía, past & present temporal markers; travel, historical periods, stages of life

A2.name: Momentos especiales
A2.scope: irregular forms of the pretérito indefinido, contrast pretérito indefinido vs imperfecto, past of estar + gerundio, temporal markers for narrating; historical events, emotions
